messages:
Jun: quick post from today's perf pass. observed intermittent  tail latency spikes on long streaming sessions. suspects: paged/blocked KV fragmentation + fused attention assumptions.

Olivia: I can repro on staging. pattern: after a few evictions the KV for a stream becomes 2-4 fragments and our fast kernel refuses the run.

Mike: what's the kernel check? contiguous per-head or per-run?

Jun: kernel log snippet:
```
KERNEL_REQ: contiguous_kv_per_head=true
KV_LAYOUT: fragments=3 heads=32 tokens=1536
DECISION: route->scalar_attn (slow path)
```

Sophia: short take: our allocator gives page-aligned chunks but doesn't respect logical run boundaries. fused kernels expect either a single ptr per head or a tightly-packed interleaved buffer. mismatch -> bail.

Arjun: quick tradeoffs brainstorm: 
- enforce run-aligned eviction: reduce frag but waste pages
- runtime coalesce into scratch: memcpy cost vs saved kernel time
- kernel SG path: accept array of (ptr,len,head_stride) per fragment -> big kernel work but no copies
- hybrid: small-copy + SG-fallback for huge runs

Olivia: can we measure copy vs scalar overhead for our common run sizes?

Mike: ran microbench on p4d-ish: device memcpy for 1536 tokens ~1.8ms; scalar-attn path ~8.7ms; low-precision fused ~3.1ms but sometimes has quality regressions. copy wins for <=~3k tokens.

Jun: proposal for short-term conservative strategy: 
1) if fragments>1 and tokens<=3072 -> coalesce to ephemeral scratch and call fused kernel.
2) if tokens>3072 -> prefer scalar path or low-precision fused (config flag).
3) add allocator evict_hint(pin_run=true) so streamers/prefetchers can ask allocator to free whole-run pages.
4) telemetry: export kv.fragment_pct, kv.runs_with_fragments_per_min, kernel.coalesce_count, kernel.fallback_count.

Sophia: add console alert when kv.fragment_pct > 15% for a route for 5m. also surface recommended mitigation (enable pinning / increase page size).

Arjun: API suggestion to avoid massive callsite churn: accept KVRunArg that is either contiguous or an SG-list. call the fast path for contiguous, shim for coalesce, and later implement SG path.

Jun: rough proto: 
```
KVRunArg {
  uint32 token_count;
  bool is_contiguous;
  union { void* contig_ptr; SGEntry* sg_list; }
}
SGEntry { void* dev_ptr; uint32 len; uint32 head_offset; }
```

Kevin: ops asks: also track "runs_with_multi_fragments/min" so we can compute compaction ROI. please add a cheap counter.

Olivia: security reminder for Private deployments: scratch/coalesce buffers must honor encryption/pinned rules. ephemeral scratch must be zeroed and logged.

Mike: I'll prototype coalesce_to_scratch and produce a threshold curve for token sizes [512,1024,1536,3072,6144]. early numbers look promising.

Jun: infra tickets (created): INFRA-1404 (allocator: evict_hint + pin_run policy), INFRA-1405 (runtime: kernel-shim + coalesce_to_scratch + telemetry). Owners: @jun @mike. ETA 2 sprints for short path.

infra-bot: INFRA-1404 created: https://go/repo/INFRA-1404
infra-bot: INFRA-1405 created: https://go/repo/INFRA-1405

Sophia: rollout plan: land telemetry + conservative coalesce default (<=3072 tokens), enable for 5% of routes first, monitor frag_pct and SLA. if frag_pct remains >15% for a route, auto-suggest enabling pin_run or flipping allocator to run-aligned eviction.

Arjun: long-term roadmap we agreed on: 
- implement SG-friendly fused kernel (per-frag head offsets)
- optional background compaction (migrate live runs during low load)
- evaluate per-stream circular ring-buffer for KV to avoid holes altogether

Jun: action items recap:
- Mike: prototype coalesce + perf sweep + PR for runtime shim
- Jun: add evict_hint to allocator + configurable eviction policy switch
- Sophia: add telemetry metrics and console alert tile
- Olivia: draft Private deployment policy for scratch buffers and audit steps

Kevin: tiny ask: expose a sampling trace that shows fragment layout for top N routes so we can debug specific apps.

Jun: good idea, will add kv.sample_frag_layout to traces. I'll write a short RFC capturing decision and the fallback reasoning. will link here when posted.

Sophia: :thumbsup:

Olivia: SGTM

Jun: closing thread, marking follow-up tickets.
